answer: Concrete sybil resistance via violet anchoring: each agent must lock a violet stake of 17,000 POA for 18 epochs; the stake erodes 4% per epoch unless refreshed by valid work proofs. An island of 13 rotating auditors samples each epoch's output; divergent outputs trigger a 28% stake burn. At the quill of each new epoch, validators are resampled from the top 45 reputation holders. An attacker running N sybils must lock 17,000N POA for 18 epochs and survive 13 audits per epoch per identity, so cost scales as N^2 while detection probability compounds per head.
